description: Conveyance, Veneration and Exposition of the Sacred Relics of Lord Buddha at the Maha Vipassana Meditation Center in Texas, America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sacred Relics discovered during the excavation of the Nilgiri Stupa dating back to 1-2 BC located in the Lahugala Divisional Secretariat Division in the Ampara District, Sacred Relics of hairs of Lord Buddha donated by the Government of Thailand and enshrined in the Gangaramaya Temple and the Sacred Relics enshrined in the Mahiyangana Rajamaha Viharaya have been subjected to the deep reverence and veneration of the Buddhist people in this country. Ven. Rathanaguna Thero and Ven. Pannakara Thero of the Maha Vipassana Meditation Center in the United States of America have made a request to organize the exposition and veneration of the said Sacred Relics at the said Meditation Center from 2026 05 02 to 2026 05 10. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to convey the said Sacred Relics to the Maha Vipassana Meditation Center in the United States of America and to provide the opportunity for devotees to pay homage to the said Sacred Relics, was approved by the Cabinet.
